cross_verification.note_en: Directly fetched (browser) from Vanuatu Department of Immigration and Passport Services, official page 'Vanuatu Citizen Passport': 'Attach with your application two recent ID photographs. All photographs must be within the dimensions of 3.5cm X 4.5cm. It is important that an identity witness must sign and write the date the back of the photo.' Size matches DB exactly. A companion official page (immigration.gov.vu/passport-forms/) additionally gives grooming guidance (neat haircut/beard, clear skin) but this is positive grooming advice, not a codified restriction category (clothing/expression/glasses/ears/face-visibility/headwear/accessories), so it was not mapped into restrictions_i18n. No official Vanuatu source stating background colour, head-height ratio, photo validity window, or glasses/headwear rules could be located despite checking immigration.gov.vu, the Vanuatu Citizenship Office (vancitizenship.gov.vu — TLS certificate error), and the eVisa portal (evisa.gov.vu — JS-rendered, no extractable text).
